newsitem.title: ESTONIA: CENTRAL BANK APPROVES UHIS /PEP MERGER.
newsitem.headline: CENTRAL BANK APPROVES UHIS /PEP MERGER.

text.p: The Estonian central bank on Friday gave Uhispank permission to merge with Pohja-Eesti Pank, Uhispank said on Monday.
This means that Pohja-Eesti Pank formally ceases to end its acitivities, Uhispank added in a statement.
The banks have essentialy already been merged as the last Pohja-Eesti Pank branch was merged with Uhispank on April 11.
Uhispank and former state bank, Pohja-Eesti Pank, the sixth largest, signed their merger agreement on January 5.
Uhispank share holders approved the merger on April 12.
Uhispank has said earlier it will consolidate Pohja-Eesti Pank into its balance sheet on May 26.
